children: In relation to Landsbankinn’s covered bond auction yesterday, was a covered bond exchange offering where holders of the series LBANK CBI 26 could sell the covered bonds in the series against covered bonds bought in the auction at a predefined clean price of 99.735.
The covered bond exchange offering results in Landsbankinn buying ISK 1,300m in the series LBANK CBI 26.
Settlement will take place on 16 September 2026.

title: Landsbankinn hf.: Covered bond exchange offering results
